remaining_gaps: The complete original assigns Treasury narcotics administration in section 2(12) and Coast Guard functions in section 2(16). EO 11490 section 101 explicitly says assignments were adjusted for intervening organization changes, and section 301 no longer includes those functions. The exact earlier transfer instruments, savings, and effective dates must be examined before asserting a common 1969 first cessation. No transfer date is established in this pilot.
